# Vendored assets

Served from the app itself so the mascot loads fast, works offline and
gets long-lived cache headers (`/static/vendor/*`, `/static/assets/*`).

| File | Source | License |
|------|--------|---------|
| `model-viewer-4.3.1.min.js` | [`@google/model-viewer@4.3.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@google/model-viewer) | Apache-2.0 (bundles three.js, MIT) |
| `../assets/robot.glb` | `RobotExpressive.glb` from the [three.js examples](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/dev/examples/models/gltf/RobotExpressive) by Tomás Laulhé | CC0 1.0 |
